title: ID0423469-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/T1 170004362] charger rebooting suddenly
description:
Reported issue: The charger suddenly went to rebooting loop. We tried to perform an on-site intervention by fixing the issue by performing the following procedure:
1. Receiving from L3 support the Live Linux and the configuration file;
2. Following the procedure for updating the Live Linux with USB stick and Flash the CFast Card with Companion tool and isert into the charger.
3. Unfortunately the USB stick has not been read from the charger. Therefore, by inserting only the CFast card went to bood mode until reach the new ID. I attached the new display of the charger.
Therefore, i am asking you support for activating from SCB side the charger and configure the routers via companion tool.
Solution: Flash CFAST

additional_info.subject: ID0423469-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/SNT170004362] charger rebooting suddenly CRM:02684000223
additional_info.body:
Ciao guys! good morning. How are you doing?
Problem solved. Charger is back online, only OCPP is not but I assume these are the ones where we don't have SIM or Wired.
Let me explain something for you now. To do the restore config with Live Linux you have to follow new steps:
Turn off charger
Remove CFAST
Insert USB keyboard in PLC
Insert USB and CFAST at “same time”
Turn on charger
Keyboard
Press ESC when you see Siemens logo with instructions to press ESC
Select boot from USB.
Unfortunately I don't have any photos because we don't do this task only on the field.
Afterwards, when the charger came back online, we had an incorrect password in Router1 and as such we couldn't pass Failsafemode. I factory resetted the router and after you rebooted, the charger is back online with OCPP router with the same problem but this time it had the password from the previous charger ID.
I changed the password for Router2 to the correct one and now it's fully functional!
Please let me know if I can close this ticket.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco
